aboutGame.title: What is Shogun's Reign?
paragraphs: Shogun's Reign is an Edo-period Japan roleplay and progression experience on Roblox that opened its gates on July 25, 2026. Every player begins with little more than the clothes on their back: you work the fields to earn your first Ryō, explore bustling towns, mountain villages, shrines and noble estates, then build the wealth and reputation needed to rise through a strict feudal hierarchy.

Advancement is social as much as mechanical. You master a profession such as Farmer, Merchant, Artisan or Attendant, pick a species with its own traits and drawbacks, claim a housing plot, and earn rank through patron sponsorship rather than grinding alone. The ladder runs from laborer and tradesman up through retainer, samurai and court noble to feudal lord - and at the very top stands a single seat: Shogun.

explore.title: Explore Shogun's Reign Wiki
explore.description: Eight curated modules covering everything you need in Shogun's Reign: first-session survival, character save codes, the rank ladder, professions, the Ryō economy, the province map, katana combat and the latest patch notes.

modules.name: Shogun s Reign Beginner Guide
modules.description: The essential first steps for new players: reading the province map, choosing a safe starting settlement, earning your first Ryō and understanding the core gameplay loop.

highlights.detail: Survey the province first: towns, mountain villages, shrines, estates and the roads between them.
Stay near guarded mountain villages for your first hour to avoid unwanted player conflict.
Earn your first Ryō through labor-based trades - farming needs zero upfront investment.
Pick a profession early: Attendant, Isha healer, Performer, Farmer, Merchant or Artisan.
Climb the six-tier social ladder from peasantry toward the Shogunate through patron sponsorship.
Do not dress above your station - guards punish roleplay breaches with fines and detention.

modules.name: Shogun s Reign Codes
modules.description: How codes actually work in this experience: community character save strings, developer promotional codes and catalog asset IDs, plus the import and redemption steps for each.

highlights.label: OC Save Code
highlights.detail: Multi-segment alphanumeric string that imports a full appearance, face and clothing layers.

highlights.label: Promo Code
highlights.detail: Short phrase from the developer granting starter currency or clothing tokens during an active window.

highlights.label: Asset ID
highlights.detail: Nine-to-eleven digit numeric ID that applies a specific custom texture or historical catalog asset.

highlights.label: Import Steps
highlights.detail: Character Customization, then Save/Load, then Import Code, then paste and confirm.

modules.name: Shogun s Reign Ranks Guide
modules.description: The social progression ladder, from peasantry and tradesmen up through retainers, the martial elite and nobility, and finally the Shogunate itself.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Sovereign tier - Shogun, Daimyo and Clan Heads hold governing authority and land distribution.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Aristocracy - Court Nobles, Lady, Hatamoto and Court Scholars with palace access and high stipends.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Warrior class - Samurai, Town Guard and Ronin, authorized to carry weapons and enforce the law.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Producers and commerce - Farmers, Blacksmiths, Artisans, Shopkeepers and Wandering Merchants.

modules.name: Shogun s Reign Jobs Guide
modules.description: Available professions and money-making methods, from field labor and market trading to palace service, crafting and healing, compared by investment and risk.

highlights.label: Farmer
highlights.detail: Lowest-risk start: plow, plant, irrigate and harvest rice, vegetables or tea leaves.

highlights.label: Merchant
highlights.detail: Buy raw materials, run a market stall and resell crafted goods, dyes and street food.

highlights.label: Attendant
highlights.detail: Serve noble manors and administrative halls by preparing tea and running palace protocol.

highlights.label: Guard
highlights.detail: Patrol districts for bounties and official defense pay, but training and gear cost Ryō.

highlights.label: Artisan
highlights.detail: Build custom furnishings and assemble weapons from raw materials at crafting stations.

highlights.label: Isha
highlights.detail: Gather herbs, brew remedies and treat wounded samurai - skilled healers set their own fees.

modules.name: Shogun s Reign Economy Guide
modules.description: The Ryō currency, wealth-building systems, trading opportunities and housing upkeep, with a repeatable hourly loop for efficient progression.

highlights.label: Ryō
highlights.detail: The province's only currency, earned through labor minigames, stall sales and noble stipends.

highlights.label: Farm Loop
highlights.detail: Crop timers make farming the most predictable income - sell surplus grain to market players.

highlights.label: Merchant
highlights.detail: Capital-intensive but exponential: buy wholesale, then resell at high-traffic market intersections.

highlights.label: Housing
highlights.detail: Housing claims are the main Ryō sink, from town rowhouse to walled samurai manor.

highlights.label: Hour Loop
highlights.detail: Fifteen minutes farming, twenty on stall sales, fifteen on attendant duties, ten restocking.

highlights.label: Banking
highlights.detail: Deposit surplus Ryō with moneylenders - carrying coin on the roads invites highwaymen.

modules.name: Shogun s Reign Map Guide
modules.description: Important locations across the province, including the castle citadel, merchant quarter, bathhouse, performance grounds, housing wards and the outer perimeter.

highlights.label: Citadel
highlights.detail: The Shogun's castle: governance, high-court roleplay and military orders behind restricted gates.

highlights.label: Market
highlights.detail: Merchant quarter with a blacksmith forge, textile atelier, apothecary and player-run stalls.

highlights.label: Bathhouse
highlights.detail: Civic bathhouse, the stamina recovery hub and the most popular starter workplace for Attendants.

highlights.label: Stage
highlights.detail: Performance pavilion hosting shamisen recitals, fan dances and theatrical plays.

highlights.label: Housing
highlights.detail: Residential wards with claimable plots, from ten-by-ten rowhouses to samurai manors.

highlights.label: Perimeter
highlights.detail: Outer gates and checkpoints leading to gathering nodes and the wilderness between provinces.

modules.name: Shogun s Reign Combat Guide
modules.description: Dueling fundamentals and combat preparation: posture and stamina management, parry timing, weapon reach and the habits that get new fighters punished.

highlights.detail: Track two meters: Stamina fuels attacks and dodges, Posture absorbs blocked hits until it breaks.
A guard break stuns you for a guaranteed execution - backpedal without blocking to recover posture.
Learn your weapon's reach: Uchigatana, Nodachi, Yari, Tanto and Kanabo each scale differently.
Parry on the windup-to-swing transition, never by spamming block - each tap shrinks the active window.
Bait a whiff, then step in - whiff punishing is the cleanest unanswerable damage available.

faq.title: Shogun's Reign FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the questions new players ask most about Shogun's Reign on Roblox.

items.question: What is Shogun's Reign?
items.answer: Shogun's Reign is a free-to-play Edo-period Japan roleplay and progression experience on Roblox. You start as a penniless commoner, earn Ryō through farming, trade and service professions, and climb a six-tier feudal hierarchy from laborer to feudal lord in pursuit of the single seat of Shogun.

items.question: Is Shogun's Reign free to play?
items.answer: Yes. Shogun's Reign is free to join on Roblox and all progression systems, professions, housing claims and rank advancement are earned through gameplay. Optional Robux purchases such as the 250 R$ Private Domain pass add custom private instances and cosmetic or convenience perks rather than exclusive power.

items.question: Does Shogun's Reign have working codes?
items.answer: Shogun's Reign codes come in three forms. Character save strings are long alphanumeric codes shared by the community that import a complete avatar look, promotional codes appear only during limited developer windows, and catalog asset IDs apply specific textures. Save strings are case-sensitive, so copy them in full including every hyphen.

items.question: How do you earn Ryō fast in Shogun's Reign?
items.answer: Farming is the most reliable early income because crop timers need no upfront investment and produce goods other players buy. Once you have seed capital, run a merchant stall near the market intersection and resell crafted goods, dyes and food. Housing claims are the main Ryō sink, so bank surplus coin before travelling the connecting roads.

items.question: How do you climb the ranks in Shogun's Reign?
items.answer: Rank advancement is social rather than purely economic. Lower tiers progress through economic output such as farming and crafting, while samurai, court noble and daimyo positions require patron sponsorship, clan recognition and consistent roleplay. Ranks can also be lost through crimes, broken clan codes or prolonged inactivity.

items.question: What can you play as in Shogun's Reign?
items.answer: Character creation combines a species choice with a profession. Species options include Human, Kitsune, Oni, Tengu and Tanuki, each with its own traits and drawbacks, while professions range from Farmer, Merchant and Artisan to Attendant, Isha healer and Performer. You are never locked in and can change career paths later.
